title: Senior Sourcing Engineer
tags: Manufacturing : Undersea Dominance - Production : Supply Chain
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

The Supplier Engineering Manager drives the strategic supply network development and cost management of Anduril’s product hardware, across their lifecycles, by collaborating with suppliers and cross-functionally, including stakeholders in engineering, quality, and manufacturing.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

• Conduct supplier selection for a specific product, leveraging approved supplier list.

• Partner with strategic suppliers to accelerate product development via activities such as:

• Concept scoping to quickly solidify requirements

• Feature trade-off / trade tables

• Total Cost of Ownership modeling

• Joint design development, via clear statements of work

• Simulation of mechanical & electronics designs

• Drive commercial

• Development and execution of sourcing strategy via full market knowledge, supplier rationalisation, commodity pricing plan and effective principles to drive efficiency and cost

• Drive the development and consolidation of a manufacturing BOM, working with Quality & Manufacturing, to ramp production internally and with our suppliers with high flexibility

• Accountable for all NPI component procurement, on-time and correctly, to scale up manufacturing operations

• Manage the request for and associated verification of supplier related CAPEX throughout NPI

• Conduct value-stream mapping to optimize supply network lead time and flexibility

• Complete the BOM risk assessment and develop plan per part analysis

• Follow through completion of component qualifications by relevant stakeholders, ahead of production need dates

• Reduce complexity of supply chain through commonality optimization & component/supplier rationalisation

• Lead all cost engineering activities to converge the bottoms-up cost curve to product cost, maximizing the total cost of ownership (TCO) across the product lifecycle

• Manage ad-hoc cost issues e.g., tariffs / import export cost, and cost inflation

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Ideally has background within:

• Design & development of mechanical and/or electronics devices

• Advanced sourcing activities, including positions working as a commodity/sourcing manager

• Supplier development (technology, process, supply chain, etc.)

• Early supplier engagement, ahead of product/engineering requirement realisation

• Domain expertise must include value/procurement engineering or TCO-related work at the component & product level

• Familiarity with developing high-tech products in a high-mix, low-volume environment

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering (BSME, BSEE) or other related technical degree.

• Must be eligible to obtain an Australian NV1 clearance

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. description:

We are currently looking for a results-driven GTM Strategist to manage the outbound strategy, and communications with our international clients. This is a full-time, remote position (working EU hours).
Requirements
What you'll do ✨

• Manage the strategy and execution of Cold Email and LinkedIn Outreach campaigns for our international clients.

• Create and review messaging for outbound campaigns using AI, audience research, ICP analysis, and campaign performance insights.

• Build and improve prospecting and list-building workflows by combining multiple data sources to help our Lead Generation team create high-intent prospect lists.

• Leverage Clay for data scraping, AI, enrichment, and campaign orchestration to increase the ROI of GTM campaigns.
Optional, but strongly preferred.

• Create internal processes, best practices, training materials, and quality standards to help the Campaign Management team scale effectively.

• At least 4+ years of relevant experience in Performance/B2B Marketing, GTM, or Outbound.

• Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Lemlist, Clay, Apollo, HubSpot , and the latest AI Sales/GTM tools.

• Well-versed in prompt engineering, AI models, and AI-assisted GTM workflows .

• Tech-savvy and a quick learner of new technologies and software. New tools appear every day, and we need you to stay on top of the market.

• Experience in Tech, SaaS, software, B2B services, or high-growth start-up environments.

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to guide clients, support team members, explain campaign results, and turn data into clear strategic recommendations.

• Open to experienced Sales Executives, Campaign Managers, GTM Specialists, or Outbound Strategists with relevant leadership or mentoring experience.

Benefits

In addition to our unique structure that lets you own your work and choose where to focus, we also offer these fun perks and benefits:

• Ability to work remotely (no more commutes!)

• Collaborative, friendly, and passionate team

• Paid vacation, days off, and sick leaves

• Exciting team-building activities

• Free books and Kindles to help you become a better marketer and person

• Specialized training programs to become a Clay Expert and build your personal brand

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. WHY JOIN US?
At When We First , you will be at the forefront of innovation in the dating industry. As a brand-new, female-founded company with over 14 years of experience in the dating industry and 20 years in tech and wellness, our executive team is passionate about blending human interaction with technology. You’ll work alongside dedicated professionals helping people form meaningful connections, all while enjoying the flexibility of a fully remote position. Join us in shaping the future of matchmaking!

In this remote role, you will work alongside a team of sales reps, profile reviewers, and matchmakers, occasionally stepping into the review of profile reviewers or matchmaking coaches during our launch phase. • Conduct sales interviews with potential clients and meet personal sales targets.

• Collaborate with the executive team to establish bi-weekly and monthly sales targets for growth and scaling.

• Adhere to When We First ’s policies, procedures, training guidelines, scripts, mission, vision, and values.

• Communicate with When We First customers via phone, email, or text for sales inquiries or customer service escalations, ensuring quality assurance.

• Help coordinate or attend launch/recruiting events in your region as needed.

• Manage and update client profiles in Salesforce, Segment, and the in-app system (training provided).

• Monitor sales calls and log all client interactions, ensuring seamless CRM updates.

• May assist in recruiting “matches” to support the matchmaking team during the launch phase, as well as coaching and profile reviews.

QUALIFICATIONS

• At least five years of proven success in sales, ideally within the dating industry. Matchmaking experience is a plus.

• A proven track record of working successfully with high-end clients in the matchmaking industry.

• Strong client service background and ability to create and maintain a positive team environment.

• Experience working in both face-to-face and remote environments.

• Excellent interpersonal, communication, and conflict resolution skills.

• Proficiency with CRM systems (especially Salesforce), Outlook, and softphone technology, with a willingness to learn new systems.

• Ability to multitask and manage client and team relationships in a fast-paced, tech-driven environment.

• Organized, detail-oriented, and thorough in documenting interactions.

• Demonstrated leadership competency and the ability to continuously improve professional skills through self-education, training, and webinars.

COMPENSATION
Base salary is commensurate with experience. Total compensation includes base plus commissions/incentives.
Total compensation $75k-$175k.

title: Manager, Sales Development & Enablement
description:
ABOUT STREAM

Stream powers real-time Chat, Video, Activity Feeds, and AI Moderation for more than 1 billion end users across 4,000+ apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Manager, Sales Development & Enablement to join Stream on our mission of elevating the quality of apps for billions of users globally. You'll own the SDR team's targets, its people, and the enablement program that decides how fast new reps ramp.

This is a full-time, hybrid role based in our Boulder office, with 3 days a week in the office.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

You'll lead a team of 6+ SDRs and report to the VP of Revenue Operations. Half of this job is management: coaching, hiring, and holding the team to its number. The other half is enablement: you own the onboarding curriculum, certification and playbook, so you build how the team works instead of inheriting it. You'll work closely with Account Executives and Sales leadership on pipeline quality, and with Marketing, Product Marketing and Sales Engineering to keep messaging current as we ship. Success is measured by team quota attainment, ramp time, and the quality of the pipeline the team hands to AEs.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Own the number: set team objectives against the revenue plan, track monthly, quarterly and annual targets, and report performance to Sales leadership.

- Lead the team: run one-to-ones, call coaching, performance reviews and development plans for SDRs at every level, with clear accountability for results.

- Build enablement: design and run the onboarding curriculum, certification path, call-coaching framework and ongoing skills programs.

- Keep the playbook current: own messaging, objection handling and qualification criteria, and update them with Product Marketing, Marketing and Sales Engineering as products and the market change.

- Hire and scale: partner with Talent Acquisition to run the interview process, set the bar, and onboard new SDRs.

- Run coverage: allocate territories, accounts and resources across the team, and adjust as segments and priorities shift.

- Manage with data: use Salesforce and Gong to diagnose performance, run call reviews, improve conversion, ramp time and meeting quality, and agree hand-off and pipeline standards with AE leadership.

ABOUT YOU

You're a manager who still gets on the phone. When a rep is stuck, you show them what good sounds like rather than describing it. You like building the system as much as running the team: a curriculum, a certification, a playbook new hires can actually use. Stream is a scale-up, so priorities move and not everything is defined yet. If you want a finished sales machine to manage, this probably isn't the role. If you want to build one, it is.

YOU HAVE:

- 1+ years managing a sales development or inside sales team, with direct accountability for team quota

- 3+ years in SaaS sales, including time as an SDR or in a comparable outbound role

- Experience building or substantially improving enablement assets: onboarding programs, playbooks, certification or coaching frameworks

- A track record of hiring, ramping and retaining early-career sales talent

- Fluency with Claude, Salesforce, Gong and modern prospecting and engagement tools, and the habit of managing performance with data

- A hands-on coaching style, with the credibility to get on a call and set the standard yourself

BONUS POINTS:

- Growing an outbound team at an API-led, developer-focused or infrastructure SaaS company

- Formal sales enablement experience, or owning an enablement function alongside a management role

- Managing across US and EMEA time zones

- Embedding a sales methodology (MEDDIC, Command of the Message or similar) in a curriculum

- Experience as an SDR at a high-growth company

title: Forensic Analyst
description:
KLDiscovery brings clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide. Our global Forensics team collects, preserves, and analyzes the data that legal matters depend on, and it runs around the clock across the US, EMEA, and APAC
As a Forensic Analyst based in India, you join the India-based group of that global team and work US Central hours, including weekends, so our clients have forensic coverage when they need it. You start with high-volume, well-defined work: cloud data collections, mobile device report exports, chain of custody documentation, and ticket triage, all under structured training from the US team. As your skills and certifications build, your ownership grows, from supervised tickets to independent handling of assigned ticket types to standalone weekend coverage. This is a role for someone who wants to build a career in digital forensics inside a global practice, with a clear path and real responsibility early.
What You'll Be Doing
Collections and Evidence Handling

• Process cloud data collections from Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, and similar sources following KLD Standard Operating Procedures.

• Generate mobile device report exports from forensic tool outputs (Cellebrite, Oxygen Forensics, Magnet AXIOM, or equivalent).

• Maintain chain of custody documentation and evidence handling logs to the KLD standard, and keep case records and ticket notes complete and current.

• Travel within India for onsite data collection or evidence and media handover when a matter requires it.

Ticket Triage and Weekend Coverage

• Triage, tag, and route incoming forensics tickets in KLD's work management system, and claim and action Tier 1 and Tier 2 requests within SLA, with quality control requests taking priority over new tickets of the same tier.

• Monitor the collections and escalation channels during your shift, and alert the on-duty Weekend Coverage Manager to priority requests.

• Execute time-dependent, scheduled, and prioritized cloud and remote collections during weekend coverage windows.

• Escalate anything client-facing, legally sensitive, or outside a defined SOP to the US team, and provide clear handoff notes at the end of every shift so service continues without interruption.

Learning, Certification, and Growth

• Complete structured training, shadowing, and certification milestones set by the US team, and work independently on each ticket type once certified.

• Contribute to and maintain the internal knowledge base and SOP documentation as you learn.

• Build toward standalone coverage of routine ticket types and, over time, broader collection and analysis work as trust and skills grow.

• Lead with the four values. Client is Always in the Room. Own the Outcome. Better Every Day. Deliver Results Together.

What You Should Already Have

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 1 to 3 years in digital forensics, IT operations, a helpdesk or ticketing environment, or a similar structured technical role. Strong aptitude and attention to detail can substitute for direct forensics experience.

• Exposure to forensic tools (Cellebrite, Magnet AXIOM, EnCase, FTK, Oxygen Forensics, X-Ways, or similar) is a plus, not a requirement. Training is provided.

• Basic scripting (Python, PowerShell, or Bash) is a plus, not a requirement.

• Strong written English for documentation and ticket notes. Fluent spoken English for daily work with US, UK, and APAC colleagues. Client-facing communication is required at the start.

• Comfortable with a sustained US-aligned night schedule that includes Saturday and Sunday, and able to work independently once certified while following escalation protocols.

• Able and willing to travel within India for onsite collection or media handover as required.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
As a Technical Support Specialist, you’ll be a customer-facing member of our Tier 2 support team, handling product issues that require deeper troubleshooting or coordination beyond frontline support.
You’ll use company's procedures and diagnostic tools to investigate issues, guide customers through next steps by phone, email, and SMS, and coordinate with service partners when a field visit is needed. When an issue requires Engineering input, you’ll gather the relevant findings and provide a clear escalation. You’ll remain responsible for customer communication and follow-up as the case moves toward resolution.
What you'll own:

• Troubleshoot known product issues with customers using company's procedures and diagnostic tools.

• Ask effective diagnostic questions, document findings, and determine the appropriate next step.

• Own assigned cases through resolution, including timely customer updates and follow-up.

• Coordinate customers, service partners, and internal teams to arrange field visits and track outcomes.

• Escalate complex issues to Engineering with a clear summary of symptoms, troubleshooting completed, and supporting information.

• Maintain accurate case records in Zendesk, Jira, and other support systems.

• Identify gaps or recurring issues and help improve troubleshooting procedures, support documentation, and tools.

• Work closely with Customer Experience, Field, and Engineering as support processes evolve

Requirements

• 3+ years in customer-facing technical support or remote troubleshooting. Hardware, connected devices, appliances, or field service experience is a strong plus.

• Must have prior US-hours experience.

• Has helped build or standardize processes (SOPs, macros, knowledge base, escalation paths). Can work in gray areas without a script.

• Comfortable talking to both non-technical end users and engineers or field techs.

• Individual contributor, not a team lead, but brings enough seniority.

• Spanish/English bilingual is strongly preferred.

Nice to have:

• HVAC experience is last on the nice-to-have list. Technical aptitude, critical thinking, and phone skills come first.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
Hardware Operations Program Manager
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

In this role, you will bridge high-rate, agile hardware iteration with the rigorous quality, safety, and field-reliability requirements of heavy, mission-critical physical hardware. You will own product manufacturing execution and operational bring-up-from early prototype builds through validation and commercial launch readiness-working directly with contract manufacturers, tier-1 suppliers, and system integrators.

AT APPLIED INTUITION, YOU WILL:

DUAL-DOMAIN PROGRAM EXECUTION (NPI & VALIDATION BRING-UP)

- Drive end-to-end operational execution for complex physical hardware systems combining high-density electronics, embedded compute, sensors, hydraulics, or ruggedized enclosures.

- Manage build schedules, clear-to-build (CTB) tracking, and milestone gates (Proto, EVT, DVT, PVT) across contract manufacturers (CMs), joint-development partners (JDMs), and internal engineering teams.

- Balance the speed and rapid lifecycle expectations of consumer technology with the safety, compliance, and field-durability demands of industrial/heavy-vehicle deployments.

SUPPLY CHAIN, SOURCING & COST MANAGEMENT

- Oversee BOM (Bill of Materials) risk management, identifying single-source components, long-lead industrial parts, and availability risks early in the design phase.

- Drive design-for-manufacturability (DFM/DFA) and design-for-serviceability (DFS) reviews alongside Mechanical, Electrical, and Systems Engineering.

- Partner with Strategic Sourcing to track product COGS, manage tooling NRE budgets, and execute cost-reduction roadmaps.

QUALITY, FACTORY BRING-UP & FIELD READINESS

title: Care Guide
description:
Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.
At Teladoc Health , you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.
Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.
Summary of Position
The Care Guide exists to restore trust, clarity, and continuity in healthcare by serving as a dedicated, relationship-driven partner for members. This role is accountable for the ongoing patient experience , not isolated transactions. It blends concierge-level service, care navigation, health coaching, and foundational medical assistant support into a single, high-trust relationship.

Care Guides are supported by an AI Companion that assists with care delivery by helping summarize interactions, surface insights, anticipate next steps, and streamline follow-up-allowing the Care Guide to spend more time building meaningful member relationships.

While this role incorporates select Health Coach and Medical Assistant capabilities, the Care Guide remains distinct: relationship ownership comes first, with coaching and coordination activities deployed in service of continuity, engagement, and follow-through-not as standalone functions.

This is not call-center support, utilization management, or task-only care coordination. It is a proactive, human-centered role modeled after premium relationship based, concierge services and high-touch clientele relationship management that borrows service standards from luxury hospitality, premium retail, and white-glove client experience.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
1. Patient Relationship Management

• Serve as the primary point of contact for an assigned panel of members, building longitudinal relationships grounded in trust, reliability, and follow-through.

• Conduct proactive outreach and regular check-ins to assess understanding, progress, barriers, and evolving needs.

• Anticipate next steps in a member’s care journey and reduce friction by absorbing system complexity on their behalf.

• Maintain complete, timely, and accurate documentation of all patient interactions and communications in the EHR and supporting tools.

2. Coaching & Behavior Change Support

• Apply motivational interviewing and coaching techniques to support sustainable behavior change, self-management, and engagement in care.

• Assess member needs related to knowledge, skills, motivation, and barriers; tailor education and support accordingly.

• Reinforce care plans for chronic conditions (e.g., hypertension, diabetes), including lifestyle modification, medication adherence, and home monitoring.

• Hold members accountable to goals through empathetic, supportive follow-up while maintaining a non-judgmental coaching stance.

• Refer members to appropriate education, programs, or clinical support in alignment with evidence-based guidelines.

Coaching is embedded within the ongoing relationship-not delivered as episodic or standalone coaching sessions.

3. Care Coordination & Navigation

• Partner closely with the Care Pod, including clinicians and care team members, to reinforce care plans and follow-up instructions.

• Support care coordination activities, including Scheduling internal and external appointments, facilitating referrals and prior authorizations, Collecting and organizing medical records, & supporting diagnostic testing and specialty care coordination

• Obtain, document, and maintain accurate medical history, biometric data, and relevant clinical information in the EHR.

• Identify social, financial, or access barriers and connect members to appropriate community or internal resources.

• Escalate clinical concerns or complex needs promptly and appropriately to licensed providers.

The Care Guide supports care delivery but does not replace licensed clinical decision-making.

title: Senior Product Designer - L5
description:
SENIOR PRODUCT DESIGNER
📍 MANCHESTER (HYBRID, UP TO 4 DAYS WFH)

💰 £50K-£65K DOE

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK, building the technology estate and letting agents use to run their businesses.

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to own onboarding for Street.co.uk http://Street.co.uk, our sales and lettings CRM. Switching CRM is a big decision for an estate agency. It means moving years of data, setting up branches, roles and permissions, and getting every agent confident from day one. That makes onboarding one of the most important areas for our growth, and we're rethinking all of it.

You'll own the end-to-end journey, from the moment an agency signs to the point their team is running their business on Street.co.uk http://Street.co.uk. You won't be handed a brief. You'll find the problems, decide what matters most, and work with our onboarding team, PMs, engineers, support and commercial to fix them.

How we work:

- Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and test a prototype the same day. We don't guess; we ask.

- We don't believe in rigid, box-ticking processes. Sometimes you need a deep discovery phase; sometimes you just need to trust your intuition and ship. We trust you to know the difference.

HERE'S WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT TO BE WORKING ON AS AN L5 SENIOR PRODUCT DESIGNER AT STREET GROUP

- Partner with PMs and Engineers to shape the roadmap and decide what we build next. You'll identify problem areas worth solving and propose them - not wait for them to land in your queue.

- Define what success looks like before you ship. Measure how it performs after release using analytics, support data and customer feedback. Adjust.

- Jump on calls with users or visit them in-branch to understand pain points and test new workflows.

- Move from low-fi sketches to high-fidelity prototypes - picking the right tool and fidelity for the job, whether that's Figma, paper, or a Claude Code prototype.

- Leverage an AI-native, code-first workflow: use tools like Claude Code to "vibe code" small UI tweaks directly in the live product, get instant answers on technical constraints without waiting on engineers, and iterate your designs in the actual browser to drastically speed up feedback loops.

- Bring AI thinking to what we build, not just how we build it - design AI experiences in the product where they genuinely help users, and call them out where they'd be gimmicks.

WHY YOU SHOULD (AND SHOULDN'T) APPLY

title: Utilization Management Specialist
description:
Align yourself with an organization that has a reputation for excellence! Cedars-Sinai was awarded the National Research Corporation’s Consumer Choice Award 19 times for providing the highest-quality medical care in Los Angeles. We also were awarded the Advisory Board Company’s Workplace of the Year. This annual award recognizes hospitals and health systems nationwide that have outstanding levels of employee engagement. We offer an outstanding benefits package that includes health care, paid time off, and a 403(B). Join us! Discover why U.S. News & World Report has named us one of America’s Best Hospitals.
What You Will Do in This Role:
The Utilization Management Specialist provides advanced operational and workflow support to Utilization Review (UR) Nurses to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant execution of the utilization review process. This position performs complex, non-clinical functions that directly support payer communication, authorization coordination, documentation integrity, and regulatory compliance.
The Utilization Management Specialist maintains an assigned portfolio of cases in partnership with multiple UR Nurses and is accountable for oversight of authorization workflows from initial submission, follow-up through to final determination. The role applies independent judgment in prioritizing cases based on payer deadlines, regulatory requirements, and authorization expiration risk.
In collaboration with UR Nurses, Case Management, Revenue Cycle, and external payers, the Utilization Management Specialist ensures documentation and authorization activities are complete, accurate, and executed within established timeframes. This position plays a critical role in supporting revenue integrity, denial prevention, and compliance with CMS and payer specific requirements.
The role operates in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment using EPIC/CS-Link, AIDIN, payer portals, and related UM systems to proactively manage workflows and remove administrative barriers that could delay review completion or payer communication.

• Maintain an assigned portfolio of cases in partnership with UR Nurses to support timely utilization review activities.

• Prepare and assemble clinical review packets and supporting documentation for payer submission.

• Review records to confirm required documentation elements are present prior to submission and escalate gaps to the assigned UR Nurse.

• Track submission confirmations and ensure timely follow up on pending payer determinations.

• Manage the authorization lifecycle for assigned cases, including entry, tracking, follow up, documentation of determinations, and monitoring of payer response timelines.

• Monitor payer portals and contact payers directly, as needed, to obtain authorization updates and resolve status discrepancies.

• Independently prioritize cases based on submission deadlines, authorization expiration risk, and regulatory timeframes.

• Escalate urgent authorization issues, delays, or barriers that may result in avoidable denials or authorization lapses.

• Coordinate peer to peer scheduling logistics and maintain related documentation.

• Document and communicate payer determinations, including approvals, partial approvals, and denials, in EPIC/CS-Link in accordance with departmental and regulatory standards.

• Identify patterns or systemic authorization workflow issues and communicate trends to UM leadership.

• Document and communicate payer determinations, including approvals, partial approvals, and denials.

• Ensure all required documentation is accurately entered into EPIC/CS-Link in accordance with departmental and regulatory standards.

• Communicate effectively with internal and external partners to ensure patient and authorization information is current and complete.

*Approved Remote States: Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Minnesota, Nevada, Oregon, Texas*

title: Energy Associate
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

Role Scope

- Diligence prospective sites across both paths to power, grid interconnection and behind-the-meter generation, and turn each one into a go or no-go recommendation in days rather than weeks.

- Build and own the delivered cost of power model across candidate sites and both paths, from tariffs and network upgrade exposure on the grid side to gas basis, transport, heat rate, and availability behind the meter.

- Be the single source of truth on where every site stands, queue position and study milestones on the grid side, contracted fuel and generation position behind the meter, and what has to happen next on each.

- Run the diligence file on every live site, tariff filings and interconnection studies, pipeline and interconnect agreements, air permits, offtake term sheets, and generation specifications, kept clean enough to walk a counterparty or a lender through cold.

- Support the Leads through live negotiations with term sheet comparisons, sensitivity runs, counterparty and credit screens, and the one number that decides the question, delivered before the next call rather than after it.

- Track the markets and the policy that set the rules we build under, ISO large load processes, rate cases and tariff changes, and gas fundamentals in the basins we are buying into.

What We're Looking For

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would.

- You've built a model that someone traded, invested, or committed capital off, and you can defend every assumption in it under pressure.

- You've read a contract, tariff, or study report closely and pulled out the two or three terms that actually change the economics, rather than summarising the whole thing.

- You turn a disordered data room into a one page recommendation that names the thing the decision actually turns on.

- You've caught a material error in someone else's work before it reached a decision maker, and you raised it rather than working around it.

- You've been dropped into a market or an asset class you did not know and been useful inside a few weeks, and you can point to how you got up to speed.

- You write up what you found the same day you found it, so a site file never depends on what is in your head.

title: Lead Machine Learning Engineer
description:
WHY FACULTY?

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here https://faculty.ai/impact.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

ABOUT THE TEAM

 

Our Public Services Business Unit is committed to leveraging AI for the benefit of individual citizens and the public good.

From our work informing strategic government decisions, to optimising our NHS, through to reducing bureaucratic backlogs - we know that AI offers opportunities to drive improvements at every level of Government and we are proud to lead on some of the most impactful work happening in the sector.

Because of the nature of the work we do with our Government clients, you may need to be eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and willing to work on site with these clients from time to time.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Lead Machine Learning Engineer at Faculty, you will set the technical direction for complex AI/ML projects, ensuring models perform at scale and in production over time by balancing technical trade-offs and guiding team priorities.

You will lead the delivery of large-scale AI-powered platforms in high-risk environments while defining project roadmaps across multiple complex workstreams.

This is an ambitious, entrepreneurial leadership role where you will act as a trusted technical expert, defending your architectural rationale to senior stakeholders to ensure we deliver high-quality, high-value outputs.

 
 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

- Designing, implementing, and maintaining reliable, scalable ML systems while justifying key architectural decisions for production environments.

- Driving the development of shared libraries and infrastructure for model deployment, lifecycle management, and CI/CD pipelines.

- Leading model integration with infrastructure by creating APIs and services that enable scalable AI functionality in applications.

- Overseeing the delivery of multiple complex workstreams and defining project problems in high-risk environments.

- Ensuring reliable model performance by defining testing frameworks and model versioning systems for senior engineers to implement.

- Managing and coaching multiple individuals, setting team-wide development goals to improve technical depth and client delivery.

- Executing proactive recommendations for adopting new technologies and AI frameworks to maintain Faculty's competitive market position.

 
 

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

- You are an expert at defining technical roadmaps and managing project priorities to deliver high-stakes outcomes within high-growth environments.

- You possess mastery of cloud-native ecosystems and orchestration tools like Kubernetes to automate complex model lifecycles and robust CI/CD pipelines.

- You have a proven ability to design large-scale, AI-powered platforms and provide the technical justification for critical architectural decisions in high-risk environments.

- You bring expert-level experience in operationalising models within frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch to solve complex, high-impact business challenges.

- You define the engineering standards and architecture patterns for agentic systems, ensuring teams build to a consistent, production-grade

TeamViewer provides a leading Digital Workplace platform that connects people with technology-enabling, improving and automating digital processes to make work work better. Our software solutions harness the power of AI and shape the future of digitalization.

You will lead TeamViewer 's Enterprise Account Manager team for the Americas - a team of six Account Managers who are the sole owners of our existing enterprise customers spending $10K or more in annual recurring revenue. • Drive the renewal engine: every renewal in the book engaged well ahead of term with a value narrative, risk flagged early, and multi-year and pricing decisions escalated on a clear rule set you own with the VP.

• Hire and ramp: own recruiting, interviewing, and onboarding for open Account Manager seats, with a defined ramp plan and time-to-productivity target.
• Partner with Enterprise Solution Engineering, Customer Success, Support, Sales Operations, and Finance to remove blockers to retention and expansion; bring customer and market insight back to Product and leadership.
• Run the quarterly business review for the Account Manager team: prior-quarter results, renewals two quarters out, expansion pipeline, and whitespace by account.

• Gross and net revenue retention at or above target across the $10K+ book, with the team's forecast accurate enough to plan on.
• Every Account Manager with a current account plan on their key accounts, under the 40-account cap, and clear on their development path.
• Hand-ups from the Enterprise Account Specialist team taken on time and closed at a strong rate; clean handoffs in both directions.
• Open seats filled with the right profile and ramped on plan; regretted attrition near zero.

title: Litigation Legal Counsel
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As a Litigation Legal Counsel, you’ll work on litigation and pre-litigation matters of the Vinted group and you will be part of the legal function.

In this position, you’ll 

• Manage litigation and pre-litigation matters touching upon regulatory, consumer affairs, platform regulations, content-related matters, privacy and commercial/contractual disputes

• Handle and streamline processes related to Request for Information received from various authorities

• Advise management stakeholders on litigation strategy and risks

• Develop creative approaches to managing legal risks and resolving disputes

• Work with and coordinate outsourced legal counsels in all the jurisdictions in which we operate

• Work closely with business teams (such as Product, PR, Customer Support, and other teams to identify and address relevant legal risks)

• Build processes (e.g. training, guidelines, etc.) with other legal peers in order to support legal compliance across the company

About you 

• An experienced mid-level lawyer with a litigation background in a law firm and/or as an in-house counsel (commercial, platform and consumer-related ideally) 

• Qualification in one bar association is a plus

• Experience managing multiple high priority projects simultaneously

• Experience managing high stakes, complex litigation

• Experience dealing with authorities (request for information, regulatory litigation, etc)

• Excellent at communicating in spoken and written English

• Platform-related litigation experience is a strong plus

• Experience managing collective actions and/or European Court of Justice proceedings is a strong plus

• The skills, willingness, and initiative to own legal issues across many different jurisdictions

• Proactivity and attention to detail

• Passionate about technology-driven businesses

Work perks 

• The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme

• 25 working days of holiday

• Newest MacBook models

• Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family

• Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture

• Co-contribution meal vouchers for each workday through a convenient meal card

• Comprehensive Medical Coverage

• Frequent team-building events

• A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted

• A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 d

title: Product Platform: Backend Engineer
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

AI is being built by many companies at once. Model labs train more capable models, hyperscalers provide infrastructure and distribution, developers build new AI products, and a growing set of tools gives agents more to work with. Baseten sits at the center of all of it, as the inference platform that developers and large companies use to run AI in production.

We’re hiring a backend/distributed systems engineer to join our Product Platform in following areas:

- Commercialization, billing, and partnerships

- Developer productivity and agentic development

- Observability platform

Please come join our growing team to work on exciting problems. A few sample projects and responsibilities will include

- Design and build scalable telemetry ingest and storage pipelines for metrics, logs, and traces across Baseten’s multi-cloud infrastructure

- Own and evolve core observability platforms, driving migrations and architectural improvements that improve reliability, reduce cost, and scale with organizational growth

- Build world class commercialization and billing systems

- Work on some of the most strategic and exciting partnership integrations

- Develop internal infrastructure and tooling that improves developer velocity, CI/CD, and deployment safety.

- Own the internal AI agent platform end to end - architecture, build, rollout, operation, measurement.

- Own Baseten's testing strategy end to end - define the standards, the tiers, and the tooling that engineering teams build against.

- Drive adoption through developer experience - good defaults, clear docs, low friction - not mandate.

- Improve platform reliability through better alerting, incident tooling, and production debugging workflows.

- Lead technical design for cross-team projects and make sound tradeoffs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability.

- Partner with infrastructure, model performance, and product teams to understand what they need to see and ship faster.

- Raise the engineering bar through code review, mentorship, and clear technical writing.

REQUIREMENTS
